data.one_liner: Tools to run sync and async benchmarks with ease and control.
data.what_it_does: Provides a class-based and functional interface to measure the performance of your code. Handles both simple micro-benchmarks and complex ones with setup and teardown functions.
use_when: You need to measure the performance of synchronous code.
You need to measure the performance of asynchronous code.
You want to compare performance implementations using functional or class-based definitions.
avoid_when: You are writing standard unit or widget tests rather than performance measurements.
strengths: First-class support for both sync and async code
Offers both functional and class-based interfaces
Supports setup and teardown functions for complex benchmarks
weaknesses: Limited built-in topics or advanced ecosystem features documented
